hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- backend frontend scripts)" ]; then echo '검증 생략 — backend·frontend·scripts에 변경 없음'; else bash scripts/check.sh 2>&1; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|DROP\s+TABLE'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 1; fi
